extras: Requires a companion server (DB Cloud Relay) to be hosted separately. Does not provide end-to-end encryption.
problem: The need for a private, self-hosted, and real-time synchronization solution for Obsidian vaults without relying on third-party cloud services.
summary: Self-hosted, real-time vault synchronization for Obsidian, mirroring notes, attachments, folders, and settings across devices.
